input.quote: 6.1 Except as provided in Section 6.2, during the term of this Agreement, the Company shall not participate in any project similar to the Site on the Internet with respect to Deerskin Products or products substantially similar to Deerskin Products (including, without limitation, the products of Wilson's House of Leather, Excelled and companies similar to Wilson's House of Leather and Excelled) and HDI shall have the exclusive right to use of the "Deerskin" brand for a self-contained web site for the offering of Deerskin Products directly to the consumer on the Internet.
input.rationale: Section 6.1 binds the Company (our party) not to participate in any similar Internet project for Deerskin Products or substantially similar products, and grants HDI the exclusive right to the "Deerskin" branded consumer web site. The product category is defined, but the restriction runs "during the term of this Agreement," and Section 4.1 makes the term automatically renew for successive one-year periods, so the exclusivity is potentially indefinite rather than capped at 12 months. There is also no performance-based release: the only exit is terminating the whole Agreement, which under Section 4.2 can trigger a Termination Payment payable by the Company, and Section 1.6 gives only a one-off right tied to the initial operational deadline. That fails the fallback (defined category plus 12 months plus automatic end on service level/delivery failure) and approaches walk-away territory (exclusive dealing for the full term with no performance-based exit). Because the bargain is reciprocal — HDI takes a matching, longer restriction in Section 6.3 that benefits us — we propose the fallback rather than deleting the exclusivity: cap our restriction at twelve months from the Effective Date and release it automatically on HDI's failure to meet the Site operational date or any service level, delivery date or performance obligation. HDI's exclusive brand right and Section 6.3 are left intact.

proposal.summary: Limit Company-side exclusivity in Section 6.1 to 12 months and add automatic release on HDI performance failure
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Our playbook does not accept exclusivity binding us for an indefinitely renewing term with no performance-based exit, so we have limited Section 6.1 to twelve months from the Effective Date and provided that our restriction falls away automatically if HDI misses the Site operational dates or its service or performance obligations. HDI's reciprocal covenant in Section 6.3 and its exclusive right to the "Deerskin" branded site are unchanged.
